tenderSchedule.title: For Selection of a Service Provider for the Scanning and Indexing of Legacy Records at Sub Registrar offices under Department of Stamps & Registration, Karnataka
tenderSchedule.description: For Selection of a Service Provider for the Scanning and Indexing of Legacy Records at Sub Registrar offices under Department of Stamps & Registration, Karnataka
tenderSchedule.locationName: IGR Department of Stamps and Registration Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Inspector General of Registration and Commissioner of Stamps, Kandaaya Bhavan,8th floor, K G Road,Bengaluru-560009.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall have its registered office in Karnataka.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation / Registration Certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall possess a valid GST Registration, as applicable under law.
The Bidder shall have achieved a minimum average annual turnover of RS 82 Crore from business operations during the last three financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate from a Chartered Accountant indicating year-wise turnover for the relevant financial years, along with audited financial statements

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation / Registration Certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall comply with all applicable statutory and regulatory requirements, including applicable tax, labour, EPF, ESI and other laws.
The Bidder shall have a positive net worth as at the end of the latest audited financial year.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate from a Chartered Accountant and the latest audited financial statements.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder, as the Prime Contractor, shall have experience in successfully executing scanning and/or indexing projects involving physical documents or records, with an aggregate volume of at least 8 Crore pages successfully scanned or indexed during the last five financial years. The scope may include data entry/data capture, scanning, image processing, quality checking, indexing and archival/storage of scanned records. Ongoing projects may also be considered, subject to submission of documentary evidence of the quantity of work successfully completed and accepted as on the date of bid submission.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the RFP Sl.no 11 page no 69

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall have demonstrated its capacity to execute high-volume scanning and indexing work by satisfying either of the following requirements during the last five financial years (a) successfully completed at least one project involving 5 Crore or more pages or (b) successfully scanned, processed and delivered accepted at least 5 Crore pages in any one financial year through one or more projects.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per RFP sl no 12 Page no 69

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall have successfully executed at least one scanning and indexing project covering not less than 50 locations/sites during the last five financial years. The locations/sites may include Government offices, record rooms, branches or other geographically distributed locations covered under a single project.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work Order / Agreement and Completion / Performance Certificate indicating the number of locations/sites covered.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall demonstrate adequate financial and execution capacity to undertake the project. Where applicable, the Bid Capacity shall be determined in accordance with the formula and requirements prescribed elsewhere in the RFP.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per RFP sl no 14 Page no 70

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall demonstrate the availability of adequate scanning and related equipment required for execution of the project. The Bidder shall submit an equipment deployment plan indicating the proposed scanners, workstations, storage and processing infrastructure, and other critical equipment required for timely execution. Equipment may be owned, leased or hired, provided that the Bidder demonstrates assured availability throughout the project period.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per RFP sl no 15 Page no 70

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall have not less than 500 scanning/data-entry operators on its payroll as on the date of submission of the bid. The Bidder shall also demonstrate the availability of adequate manpower for execution of the project, including scanning operators, quality-control personnel, indexing/data-entry personnel, supervisors and technical/project-management personnel. The Bidder shall submit a proposed manpower deployment plan and project organisation structure commensurate with the project requirements.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per RFP sl no 16 Page no 71

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall possess a valid ISO/IEC 27001 certification or equivalent recognised information-security certification applicable to its organisation or services. The Bidder shall also comply with all information-security, confidentiality, access-control and data-protection requirements specified elsewhere in the RFP.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid ISO/IEC 27001 certificate or equivalent recognised information-security certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall possess a valid CMMI for Services (CMMI-SVC) Maturity Level 3 or higher appraisal as on the date of bid submission. The appraisal shall be verifiable through the CMMI Published Appraisal Results System (PARS).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per RFP sl no 18 Page no 71

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall not have been blacklisted, debarred or declared ineligible for participation in Government procurement by any Central Government or State Government Department, Government Authority, Public Sector Undertaking or Statutory Body as on the date of submission of the bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-Declaration in the prescribed format.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall disclose material litigation, arbitration or contractual disputes that may materially affect its ability to perform the Contract. The Bidder shall also disclose any contract terminated or foreclosed by a Government Department or Government Authority during the last three years on account of material non-performance or breach attributable to the Bidder.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Declaration in the prescribed format, together with details of material cases, if any.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall declare that it has no conflict of interest that would affect its ability to execute the project impartially and effectively.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Conflict of Interest Declaration in the prescribed format.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: All criteria as per the RFP

itemList.itemName: Per-page rate for scanning and Indexing of legacy documents, including preparation of records, scanning, page numbering, image processing, indexing, quality checking, storage of scanned records in the prescribed format, and uploading to the designated Central Server, as per the Scope of Work and other requirements specified in the RFP.
